subject: Fix FieldInfo namespace resolution for packaged fields
description: FieldInfo.resolveFieldInfo() does fields.get(fieldName.toLowerCase()) but in the installed package context, the field map keys include namespace prefix (cgpm__status__c). When Template_Field_Config__c stores 'Status__c', it doesn't match. Need to handle namespace-stripped lookups in FieldInfo, or fix tests. Also fix FieldInfoTest.testNumericFieldStep which assumes Opportunity.Probability has scale=2 but org has scale=0.
